terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: source "$HOME/.venv/bin/activate" && cd /workspace && if [ -n "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ] && [ -n "${SUPABASE_DB_URL:-}" ]; then exec uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; else echo "Backend not started. Add Cloud Agent secrets (OPENAI_API_KEY, LANGSMITH_API_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_DB_URL) and restart this terminal to run the live API."; fi

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd /workspace/frontend && export NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8000}" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:-https://placeholder.supabase.co}" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-placeholder-anon-key}" && exec npm run dev
